title: How Reston Town Center and Toll Road Dust Load Your Air Ducts
headline: Wiehle high-rises, Lake Anne originals, and why Reston Parkway registers film over
description: Reston, VA sits on the Dulles Toll Road with planned villages and Town Center stacks. Learn why corridor dust and humid summers load ducts, and when to book a cleaning from Burke.

sections.heading: Reston is a planned city. The dust is not planned.
paragraphs: Reston Town Center stacks condos over shops. Lake Anne still has the original plaza and lower-rise metal trunks. South Lakes and North Point mix townhomes under a heavy canopy. Every one of those buildings sits in Dulles Toll Road air. Patio furniture along Reston Parkway is the outdoor version of what your returns already hold.

The Silver Line stop at Wiehle-Reston East added rooftop packs and stacked laundry. Older Lake Anne trunks were never sized for that density of brake dust. Cool supply air plus a humid Reston July is why a wiped register looks dirty again by Friday.

sections.heading: High-rise laundry is a lint chimney
paragraphs: Town Center and Wiehle units send dryer exhaust up a long riser. Lint packs at elbows and roof caps. The closet stays hot; the machine needs two cycles. That moisture does not stay in the laundry — it sits next to the same air that already carries Toll Road film.
If supplies gray out a few days after you wipe them, start with [air duct cleaning in Reston, VA](/locations/reston).

sections.heading: Typical signs in a Reston home
listItems: Gray film on supplies facing Reston Parkway or the Toll Road.
Musty air from a Lake Anne or South Lakes unit when the AC starts after rain.
A stacked laundry closet that stays hot and a dryer that never quite finishes.

sections.heading: Burke dispatch — not a Town Center mailbox
paragraphs: Reston is served from our [Burke](/locations/burke) office. Nearby [Herndon](/locations/herndon) and [Vienna](/locations/vienna) use the same crew. There is no Reston storefront.

Book on the [Reston location page](/locations/reston). Pair ducts with [dryer vent cleaning](/dryer-vent-cleaning) if the riser is the problem, or read how [air duct cleaning](/air-duct-cleaning) works on stacked units.
listItems: Change filters more often if you face the Toll Road.
Keep indoor humidity under 50% in summer, especially in lower-level units.
Clean ducts every 3 to 5 years; clear high-rise dryer vents about once a year.

faq.q: Does Dulles Toll Road dust really reach Reston indoor ducts?
faq.a: Yes. Fine traffic particles settle on decks and at returns. Filters catch some of it. Trunks store the rest until they are cleaned.

faq.q: Do you have an office at Reston Town Center?
faq.a: No. Reston is served from Burke. We will not list a mailbox at the Town Center and call it a shop.
